name: program
description: Specs a product or feature with experts who interview the user, splits the spec into epics with a mocked horizontal foundation before vertical work, then picks a dacapo loop and a base branch per epic. Writes no code: it ends in a spec, an epic plan and a runbook of runs.

transitions.label: spec gap
transitions.when: the epic plan names gaps that block a cut
transitions.then: the run re-enters at the stage whose expert owns the first gap and walks the spec stages forward from there, consulting only the experts whose sections change

transitions.label: plan shown
transitions.when: the epic plan was shown and the user had a moment to object

transitions.label: runbook handed
transitions.when: the runbook was handed to the user with every run, its loop, base branch and command

transitions.label: functionality settled
transitions.when: the functionality expert reported and its open questions were put to the user

transitions.label: has an interface
transitions.when: the systems design expert reported and the functionality spec names a surface a person uses

transitions.label: no interface
transitions.when: the systems design expert reported and the spec names no surface a person uses; the user confirmed the spec as one document

transitions.label: spec confirmed
transitions.when: the UI/UX expert reported and the user confirmed the spec as one document

transitions.label: refine functionality
transitions.when: the user or the systems design expert wants to change what the product must do
transitions.then: the functionality expert is consulted again on the change, and the architecture stage resumes with the new section

transitions.label: rethink architecture
transitions.when: the user or the UI/UX expert wants to change how the product is built
transitions.then: the systems design expert is consulted again on the change, and the ui-ux stage resumes with the new section

transitions.label: refine functionality
transitions.when: the user or the UI/UX expert wants to change what the product must do
transitions.then: the functionality expert is consulted again, then the systems design expert where its section changes, and the ui-ux stage resumes

handovers.label: scope
handovers.spec: the change in one line and what is still open about what it must do

handovers.label: spec section
handovers.spec: the functionality spec: goal, users, must do, must not do, flows, out of scope, open questions

handovers.label: scope
handovers.spec: the change in one line, that the functionality spec is settled, and what is still open about how to build it

handovers.label: spec section
handovers.spec: the systems design spec: components, technologies, contracts, data, constraints, open questions

handovers.label: scope
handovers.spec: the change in one line, the surfaces the functionality spec names, and what is still open about the interface

handovers.label: spec section
handovers.spec: the UI/UX spec: surfaces, screen flows, references, constraints, open questions

handovers.label: spec
handovers.spec: every spec section, the repository's base branch, and whether Linear tools are available

handovers.label: epic plan
handovers.spec: components touched, contracts spelled out, foundation epics, vertical epics, order, Linear identifiers, gaps

handovers.label: epics
handovers.spec: the epic plan, the repository's base branch and the names of the loops in the library

handovers.label: runbook
handovers.spec: a base branch per epic, the foundation runs in order and the vertical runs to start together, each with its loop, reason and command
